name: speakeasy
description: Give Codex a controllable voice and agent-managed thread lanes through the native SpeakEasy menu-bar player.

interface.shortDescription: A controllable voice for your agents
interface.longDescription: Generate narration with local or configured speech providers, manage exact-task voice lanes through Codex, and listen through a permanent native macOS player with autoplay, transport controls, a word-synced HUD, and one-click return to the originating task.
defaultPrompt: Read this summary aloud in SpeakEasy.
Show and edit my SpeakEasy voice lanes.
Assign this task to my primary voice lane.
